name: A Lesson in Divinity
summary: Your order sends you to Tanis Alderwood in Undercity’s Trade Quarter. Their need offers a chance to show grace through good deeds.

sections.title: A Call for Grace
sections.body: Your order teaches that divinity means pursuing good for its own sake, not seeking godhood. It says tragedy brought you to this place, and asks you to seek Tanis Alderwood in the Trade Quarter of Undercity. Tanis is in need and may benefit from your grace.

sections.title: Tanis’s Plea
sections.body: When you approach Tanis, they fear you may hurt them. They say they have no quarrel with you or your order, and beg you to leave them be.

faq.answer: Tanis Alderwood is someone in need in Undercity’s Trade Quarter.

faq.q: Why am I sent to Tanis?
faq.answer: Your order says Tanis could benefit from your grace.

faq.q: What does divinity mean to my order?
faq.answer: It means pursuing good for its own sake, rather than seeking godhood.

faq.q: Where can I find Tanis Alderwood?
faq.answer: Tanis Alderwood is in the Trade Quarter of Undercity.

angles.text: As a priest, your order frames divinity as doing good for its own sake, and says tragedy can threaten the grace that defined you in life.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Lesson in Divinity
